candidate.summary: The remote document is parsed once, in the geometry Worker, and the main thread reads the assembly tree and the property index from what the Worker returns instead of parsing the same bytes again.

protocol.note: Nothing here is a memory cap. The runtime's 64 MiB decoded and GPU budgets bound admitted target geometry and nothing else; every figure below is outside that bound and none of it may be restated as a total-memory limit.

ledger.owner: the thread that parsed the compiled glTF document
ledger.lifetime: until the scene it describes is replaced or disposed
ledger.consumer: chunk selection in the Worker, and the assembly tree on whichever thread builds it
ledger.note: Declared Content-Length of scene.gltf, published by the Studio retention ledger.

ledger.owner: the main thread property sidecar reader
ledger.lifetime: until the scene is replaced or disposed
ledger.consumer: property resolution for the selected occurrence

ledger.owner: the main thread spatial demand source
ledger.lifetime: until the scene is replaced or disposed
ledger.note: Zero for both packages in this experiment; neither declares a spatial demand index.

ledger.owner: the main thread hierarchy sidecar reader
ledger.lifetime: until the assembly tree is built, then the decoded columns are released
ledger.note: Zero for the pinned package, which carries its tree in the document.

ledger.lifetime: until the scene is replaced or disposed
ledger.consumer: the first coarse frame and every unadmitted prototype

ledger.owner: the delivery origin, not the page
ledger.lifetime: not resident; the figure bounds what Range requests may draw from
ledger.note: Reported for scale. Only admitted chunks are resident, under the 64 MiB budget.

ledger.consumer: the primary threshold of this experiment
ledger.note: performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize, main thread only; it does not see Worker heaps.

ledger.consumer: context for the used figure; a committed heap is not a live set

ledger.owner: the whole agent cluster, page and Workers together
ledger.consumer: the cross-thread total, which moving work between threads should not change
ledger.note: performance.measureUserAgentSpecificMemory() forces a collection and blocks for seconds.

ledger.consumer: reported, not gating; it includes engine allocations this experiment does not govern
the behaviour guard; it must hold the pinned endpoint in every accepted run
would bound the true device footprint
ledger.unavailableReason: No engine measured here exposes driver-side allocation to a page; the figure is absent, not zero.
